WITH joined AS (
  SELECT 
    s.transref,
    tr.tradekind,
    s.anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg
),
pair_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    transref,
    tradekind,
    AVG(anlycount) as pair_avg_anlycount
  FROM joined
  WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY transref, tradekind
),
overall_mean_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(pair_avg_anlycount) as overall_mean FROM pair_averages
),
filtered_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    p.transref,
    p.tradekind,
    p.pair_avg_anlycount,
    (p.pair_avg_anlycount - omc.overall_mean) as amount_above_mean
  FROM pair_averages p
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean_calc omc
  WHERE p.pair_avg_anlycount > omc.overall_mean
),
trader_type_aggregates AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(pair_avg_anlycount) as avg_anlycount_of_kept_pairs,
    AVG(amount_above_mean) as avg_amount_above_mean
  FROM filtered_pairs
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
mean_of_amounts_above AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount_above_mean) as mean_avg_amount_above FROM trader_type_aggregates
)
SELECT 
  tta.tradekind,
  tta.avg_anlycount_of_kept_pairs,
  tta.avg_amount_above_mean,
  tta.avg_anlycount_of_kept_pairs / moaa.mean_avg_amount_above as ratio
FROM trader_type_aggregates tta
CROSS JOIN mean_of_amounts_above moaa
ORDER BY tta.tradekind;

alternatives.interpretation: The phrase 'divided by the mean of this figure' could refer to the mean of average analyst counts across trader types (normalizing each trader type's analyst count against the overall average) rather than against the mean of their distances above the overall pair-average threshold.
